title: Пасивний стан
rule: Passive = be + V3. Present: is deployed; Past: was fixed; Present Perfect: has been merged; Continuous: is being tested; Future: will be released; з модальними: must be signed. Виконавця додаємо через by: written by Anna. Вживаємо, коли важлива дія чи результат, а не хто її зробив.

items.prompt: The emails ___ automatically.
items.explanation: Листи не відправляють самі себе — потрібен Passive: are sent.

items.prompt: The bug ___ yesterday by Olena.
items.explanation: Yesterday + by → Past Simple Passive: was fixed.

items.prompt: Your PR ___ merged into main.
items.explanation: Present Perfect Passive: has been + V3.

items.prompt: The new feature ___ at the moment.
items.explanation: At the moment → Present Continuous Passive: is being tested.

items.prompt: The contract ___ by both parties before the project starts.
items.explanation: Модальне дієслово + be + V3.

items.prompt: English ___ in many countries.
items.explanation: Мова не говорить сама — Passive: is spoken.

items.prompt: A notification ___ to me when the build failed.
items.explanation: Минула подія (when ... failed) → Past Simple Passive.

items.prompt: Passwords should never ___ in plain text.
items.explanation: Після should — інфінітив без to: be stored.

items.prompt: The suspect is believed ___ the country last week.
items.explanation: Is believed + to have + V3 для минулої дії.

items.prompt: This code ___ by a junior developer, so be careful.
items.explanation: З by-виконавцем потрібен Passive: was written.

items.prompt: The logs ___ (store) in the cloud.
items.explanation: Present Simple Passive: are + V3.

items.prompt: The website ___ (hack) last night.
items.explanation: Минулий час, Passive: was + V3.

items.prompt: The update ___ (not / install) yet.
items.explanation: Present Perfect Passive: has not been + V3.

items.prompt: My laptop ___ (repair) right now.
items.explanation: Continuous Passive: is being + V3.

items.prompt: The report must ___ (submit) by Monday.
items.explanation: Після must — be + V3.

items.prompt: The room ___ (clean) every day.
items.explanation: Present Simple Passive: is + V3.

items.prompt: The documents are sending to the client.
answers: The documents are being sent to the client.
items.explanation: Continuous Passive потребує being + V3.

items.prompt: The app was developed from our team.
answers: The app was developed by our team.
items.explanation: Виконавця в Passive вводить by, а не from.

items.prompt: The package has been delivered yesterday.
items.explanation: З yesterday вживаємо Past Simple, не Present Perfect.

items.prompt: The database will be backup tonight.
answers: The database will be backed up tonight.
items.explanation: Після be потрібна форма V3: backed up.
